missionmed_payment_plan.public_copy: Payment plans are arranged directly with Admissions. Start with a $750 deposit; we will confirm your schedule and total in writing before anything is charged.
missionmed_payment_plan.cta_label: Talk to Admissions about a payment plan
missionmed_payment_plan._FOUNDER_REQUIREMENT: Ticket S14 is authoritative: students using the internal payment plan MUST pay a higher total than PIF, to incentivize Zelle PIF and to compensate for delayed cash and collections/default risk. This requirement is NOT withdrawn and must NOT be silently replaced with a same-total 0% plan.
missionmed_payment_plan._WHY_NOT_PUBLISHED_YET: Ticket S14 also forbids inventing or publishing an APR or a potentially noncompliant finance charge. A published premium over the PIF price is a finance charge under Reg Z 12 CFR 1026.4 regardless of what it is called, and a >4-payment schedule can confer creditor status in states with no volume threshold. Until Codex resolves the compliance path, the UI carries the higher-total ARCHITECTURE (premium_amount is configurable and rendered the moment it is set) while the offer itself is routed through the existing safe manual Admissions process. No premium number, no APR, and no 0%/same-total claim is published in the meantime.
missionmed_payment_plan._CODEX_P0: Resolve the compliant mechanism for a higher-total installment product, then set premium_amount and flip premium_published/public_total_published. Do not substitute a 0% same-total plan without written founder approval.
